HDFC Bank's New CEO: Governance Hurdle Cleared

HDFC Bank has cleared a governance hurdle for the renewal of its chief executive officer position. The board of directors has picked Rajiv Kumar, former Finance Secretary, to steer the bank. This move is seen as a significant step towards strengthening the bank's leadership and governance structure.
